data.body:
Fixes bug B0b0b67d5e7: ddflow gate run lanes-watchdog ci ran the selection to completion (log .ddflow/runs/lanes-watchdog/ci-20261113T044340619695Z-2435027.log) then crashed with a TimeoutError from _flock (30s, holder a lane heartbeat) in record_measured -> hand_approve.record, so the measured outcome was never recorded and the run was wasted; the record step needs a longer or retried lock wait Found on lanes-watchdog.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B0b0b67d5e7 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B0b0b67d5e7 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B0b0b67d5e7: gate run loses a finished ci result when the events lock times out at record time
